Name: (CR) Kisaa's Tiny Rooms Pack for PIF
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[i][center][size=3][b]🍊Tiny Rooms 2.0 Update Notice:[/b] Some of the old rooms have been revamped with new features, and the mod files have been reorganized. I recommend to do a clean install of this mod (delete the old mod files!) 🍊

﻿﻿Ever want more variety of rooms for your farmhouse? Or is your modded farmhouse too small for your decorating needs?
With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url]﻿﻿, I bring you this mini pack of versatile tiny rooms!
[/size](Furnishings not included!)[/center][/i]
[img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]12 tiny rooms for all your decorating/cluttering needs![/b]
[*][b]Upgradeable Rooms: [/b]The space in some of the rooms expand alongside farmhouse upgrades.
[*][b]... and Non-Upgradeable Rooms: [/b]There are also some rooms that do not increase in size with upgrades, if you like them to stay tiny.
[*][b](NEW!) Organized Rooms: [/b]With the new tarot PIF menu, older rooms are grouped under [b]Tiny Rooms 1.0 [/b]and newer rooms under [b]Tiny Rooms 2.0. [/b]Less clutter in the room selector menu!
[*]The rooms are empty, so you can furnish them however you like!
[/list][size=3]
[/size][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Qfc2pd7/mod-contents.png[/img]

[size=3][b]Room Expansion[/b]

[/size][list]
[*][size=2][b]Attic [/b]and [b]Closet [/b]can expand alongside farmhouse upgrades[b] up to the 2nd upgrade[/b].[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Basement, Boiler Room, Nook Room, [/b]and [b]Storeroom [/b]can expand [b]up to the 1st upgrade[/b].[/size]
[*][size=2]All other rooms remain the same size even with farmhouse upgrades. It's called Tiny Rooms pack for a reason.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]Bed/Mini-Fridge Placement[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=2]You can place mini-fridges [b]in all the rooms![/b][/size]
[*][size=2]You can place beds in [i]most [/i]rooms, with certain exceptions listed under [b]Cask Functionality [/b]below.[/size]
[*][size=2]The original 5 rooms have also been updated to allow Bed and/or Mini-Fridge placement.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]Cask Functionality[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Boiler Room, Basement,[/b] [b]Storeroom, [/b]and [b]Tiny Room 4[/b] can be used to place casks.
[*]Usually, these rooms can't have beds in them, [b]with the exception of Tiny Room 4[/b].
[/list]
[size=3][b]What Are the Rooms For?[/b][/size]

[size=2]I left them blank so you can decorate however you want - no need to conform to the listed names. But if you'd like specifics:

[list]
[*][b]Boiler Room [/b]is intended to be a storage/furnace room.
[*][b]Basement [/b]is intended to be a mini cellar/storage room.
[*][b]Closet [/b]is intended to be a pantry/bathroom/laundry room, or any combination of those.
[*][b]Nook Room [/b]is intended to be a walk-in-closet/bathroom combo.
[*][b]Storeroom [/b]has lots of space for chests!
[*][b]Attic [/b]and [b]Little Attic [/b]are for... well, attic space. Any room is a storage room if you need enough.
[*][b]Tiny Room 1-4 [/b]are the true versatile rooms - the design I had in mind doesn't conform to anything specific.
[/list][/size]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with interior recolor mods.

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url] (minimum version 1.4.2 required; using the new tarot UI is [b]highly recommended[/b]).
[*]Unzip [i]"(CR) Kisaa's Tiny Rooms Pack for PIF" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Have fun!
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Not yet properly tested on multiplayer. Feel free to and report any multiplayer-related issues back to me.
[/list]
[size=3]When reporting bugs, please follow the instructions listed on the pinned comment.[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

Thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DeLiXxN?gameId=1303]DeLiXxN [/url]for creating PIF and making this mod possible. Another special thank you on top of that for listening to my request for a new room selector UI that made me able to add this many rooms without cluttering the menu and for adding so many cool new features to play with!
